description: This Java class `BaseSavingsIntegrationTest` provides a base setup for integration tests related to savings account functionalities within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes methods to create savings products, manage savings accounts (apply, approve, activate), handle transactions (deposit), retrieve account details, and verify transactions. It also manages global configurations and business dates for testing purposes, utilizing libraries such as RestAssured, Lombok, JUnit, and custom Fineract client helpers.

classes.name: BaseSavingsIntegrationTest
classes.description: A base class for integration tests related to savings accounts, providing common setup, utility methods for creating and managing savings accounts, transactions, and configurations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: runFromToInclusive
methods.description: Runs a consumer over a range of dates inclusively, advancing the business date for each day.

methods.name: runAt
methods.description: Sets the business date to a specific date and runs a consumer or runnable within that date context.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Performs a deposit transaction into a savings account.

methods.name: getSavingsAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the details of a specific savings account.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Fetches transactions associated with a savings account.

methods.name: verifyNoTransactions
methods.description: Verifies that there are no transactions on the specified savings account.

methods.name: verifyTransactions
methods.description: Verifies that the expected transactions exist on the savings account.

methods.name: dailyInterestPostingProduct
methods.description: Creates a request object for a daily interest posting savings product.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new savings product in the system.

methods.name: applySavingsRequest
methods.description: Prepares a request to apply for a new savings account.
